Taboo resume advice: stop being so transparent.

Putting your full address on your resume isn’t honesty — it’s giving recruiters ammo. They can judge your neighborhood, look up your house, and quietly decide how little they can pay you before you ever get a reply.

In this video, I break down resume mistakes that feel responsible but actually kill your leverage, including why you should remove your address, stop oversharing details, and avoid listing “owner” when it creates more questions than answers.

Welcome to the era of the Mega-Manager!

You didn’t get promoted.
You didn’t get a raise.
You just inherited the workload of five people who were “replaced by AI.”

The mega-employer is dead, but the work didn’t disappear. Instead, companies fired half the staff, scared everyone with RTO and AI, then handed the survivors a dashboard and said “prove your worth.”

Now managers have more reports, less time, higher burnout, and performance tracking watching everything. Engagement is down, anxiety is up, and somehow this is being sold as
